data.name: Khafif
data.gender_notes: Khafif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khafif is an Arabic name that means 'light' or 'gentle'. It is a name that symbolizes a person who is soft-spoken and kind-hearted. The name Khafif carries the meaning “Light, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khafif usually hope their child will grow to embody light, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Khafif is associated with the concept of mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Khafif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khafif total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
